en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from Muhammad Bin Isa, from Yunus, from Zurara, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Aliasws was saying that the man, when he drinks the wine, gets intoxicated, and when he is intoxicated, raves, and when he raves, he fabricates, therefore he would be whipped a Penalty (Hadd) of the fabricator’.
